llmdet.light_trains: fusion encoder, decoder, heads (Swin-L and BERT frozen)

latency_t4.notes: native PyTorch, fp16 autocast with fp32 master weights; deformable attention via kernels-community/deformable-detr CUDA kernel in fp32; input short side 800 / cap 1333
native PyTorch, fp16 autocast with fp32 master weights; deformable attention via kernels-community/deformable-detr CUDA kernel in fp32; input short side 800 / cap 1333

mmgdino.light_trains: feature enhancer, decoder, heads (Swin-B and BERT frozen)

latency_t4.notes: HF transformers MMGroundingDinoForObjectDetection, fp16 weights + fp16 autocast, short side 800 (max 1600), fixed 5-phrase prompt tokenised once outside the timer, top-300 decode + conf filter inside.

sam3.light_trains: fusion encoder, DETR decoder, heads (PE ViT trunk and text encoder frozen)

latency_t4.notes: Native PyTorch, fp32 weights under fp16 autocast, 1008x1008 input, five text prompts batched against one image encoding; text features for the fixed vocabulary cached at start-up. Segmentation head off (boxes only). Peft and full share the architecture, so one timing covers both arms.

yoloe_1280.light_trains: official linear probe: the last 1x1 conv of each class branch

latency_t4.notes: Ultralytics native PyTorch, half=True, imgsz=1280, predict() end to end incl. letterbox + NMS/top-k; masks not computed (detection-only checkpoint).

yoloe_640.light_trains: official linear probe: the last 1x1 conv of each class branch

latency_t4.notes: Ultralytics native PyTorch, half=True, imgsz=640, predict() end to end incl. letterbox + NMS/top-k; masks not computed (detection-only checkpoint).

yoloworld.light_trains: WorldDetect head (backbone, neck and CLIP text encoder frozen)

latency_t4.notes: Ultralytics native PyTorch, half=True, imgsz=1280, predict() end to end incl. letterbox + NMS/top-k; masks not computed (detection-only checkpoint).

owlv2.light_trains: detection heads + final layer norm (ViT-L and text tower frozen)

latency_t4.notes: vision tower fp16, detection heads fp32; HF Owlv2Processor (numpy, CPU) preprocessing inside the timer; decode top-300 + optional class-wise NMS.

deimv2_m.light_trains: STA adapter, hybrid encoder, decoder (DINOv3 backbone frozen)

latency_t4.notes: DEIMv2 deploy-mode model + postprocessor, fp16 via torch.autocast (model.half() breaks DINOv3 RoPE); PIL -> Resize 640 -> normalize -> forward -> top-300 -> conf filter

deimv2_l.light_trains: STA adapter, hybrid encoder, decoder (DINOv3 backbone frozen)

latency_t4.notes: DEIMv2 deploy-mode model + postprocessor, fp16 via torch.autocast (model.half() breaks DINOv3 RoPE); PIL -> Resize 640 -> normalize -> forward -> top-300 -> conf filter

latency_t4.notes: selected (better) arm: full fine-tune. num_beams=1, max_new_tokens=400; includes generation AND the teacher-forced re-scoring forward pass that produces per-box confidences, token parsing and the conf>=0.25 filter; transformers 4.49.0 remote-code Florence-2, eager attention, fp16 weights; 768x768 input

LoRA adapter merged into base weights (same architecture/FLOPs as full). num_beams=1, max_new_tokens=400; includes generation AND the teacher-forced re-scoring forward pass that produces per-box confidences, token parsing and the conf>=0.25 filter; transformers 4.49.0 remote-code Florence-2, eager attention, fp16 weights; 768x768 input

qwen3vl.light_trains: LoRA r16 on LLM attention (vision tower and mergers frozen)

latency_t4.notes: SUBSET: first 20 of 94 test images (sorted), warmup 3, 1 pass, 1 run (no same-config rerun) -- the full protocol (94 imgs x 1 pass x 2 runs) ran >2.7 h on the T4 without finishing and was killed. HF transformers 5.23 generate, greedy, max_new_tokens 2048, sdpa, fp16, torch 2.6.0+cu124, native 1920x1088 input (2090 prompt tokens). Includes per-box log-prob confidence + JSON parse.

paligemma2.light_trains: LoRA r16 on Gemma attention + projector (SigLIP frozen)

latency_t4.notes: native PyTorch fp16, greedy generate (max_new_tokens=320), transformers PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration, LoRA merged

smolvlm2.light_trains: QLoRA r16 on LLM attention + connector (SigLIP frozen)

latency_t4.notes: peft arm; LoRA merged into fp16 base (trained under 4-bit QLoRA); greedy generation up to 1024 tokens is inside the timer; passes=1 (protocol default 3 cut to bound T4 time: autoregressive JSON output)
